reviews.text: My gorgeous poodle always looks adorable after her visit. We’re very happy with the service and team. Thank you

I have a bit of an anxious dog but the people here are always so lovely to Bert. He always comes out looking handsome as hell and they’re always so nice about him. I’m grateful for this groomers and the ladies who work there

Absolutely Animals have been amazing today! My dog Morris was very hairy but also very nervous. The kindness and professionalism of the team made it so easy and made Morris look super smart. Thanks very much ❤️

Kay was so friendly and accommodating!! I felt comfortable leaving my precious cat Leo with her .we adopted for the lion 🦁 shave !! See pics before & after below . Kay & Sophia are the ones that took care of Leo .  First  2 are after  last 3 are before groom . …
Great groomers we're very happy with our style and koko is happy too.

Unprofessional and waste of money. I dropped my cat and then I received a call 2h later to collect him,  they told me that they didn’t wash or groom him because he was “aggressive” and needs to be SEDATED??? I have the calmest cat! I have taken him to previous groomers and taking him to groomers after that incident and they all said he is an angel!! Also, it is common We drop our cats to professionals because of how fussy they are (not aggressive) And they should be able to handle them. I think the ladies were being very lazy and couldn’t be bothered because they had multiple cats to handle. Oh And I want to assure you that they  kept my deposit money, which costs more than half of the service!! Pad paws & claws on lavender hill were FANTASTIC
So pleased. My dog had her teeth cleaned and they look wonderful. Was getting a bit worried about the state of them so after a recommendation took her here. Got some good advice and only 30 minutes.

Very disappointing experience.

The staff were not particularly gentle or dog-friendly, and I felt my dog was handled rather casually.

I was told that “half of the teeth” had been cleaned, but in reality, only the upper right side appeared to have been cleaned. The lower teeth, front teeth and the entire left side were untouched. It looked like less than a quarter of the teeth had actually been cleaned.

£40 for such a limited cleaning is simply not reasonable in my opinion. The overall experience was very disappointing, and I honestly don’t understand the large number of positive reviews.

Brilliant, lovely, reassuring and totally professional service. My Persian had a lot of tight mats that were removed along with a full grooming. She returned home not at all distressed and is now much more comfortable and tidy. I would totally recommend Absolute Animals for your cat too.
Grooming day with the best groomer in London 🐶✨”Luh  Thank you for always taking such good care of my Tye with so much love and care. We love you! ❤️🐶✨
They did a great Job. Wily is a fairly nervous cat, but was very relaxed after her trim.

My pup absolutely lovely’s these groomers. She pulls me in to get in. She’s always well taken care of and has an amazing cut even if she has little matts she is always done very well. She’s very energetic and although I know this can irritate the groomers she is always still welcome and enjoys her pamper! Very grateful for your patience with Dolce 🫶🏽

Brilliant Cat Groomers.

Used Absolutely Animals for my previous cat and now using them again for my current two cats.

All the staff are lovely, they’re always on time and do a brilliant job. I’ve seen them handle a very unhappy cat and they handled him really gently. My two cats love the attention the ladies give them.

See you in a month.

The service is brilliant in every way, from cost, to availability to the care taken with my best friend (Hana my dog) being left and kept safe, cared about and looked after. I couldn't ask for more!!!

I did the «  grooming your own dog experience « . It was very informative. A lovely lady called Dolce looked after me and was very friendly and knowledgeable. Everyone are friendly there and you feel welcome .

I have a long haired Maine coon who had quite a lot of matted fur as we had lost our previous groomer. I finally found Adorable and they were fantastic. He is a very big strong cat but they managed him perfectly and did a really great job and he was perfectly calm and happy when I collected him. Will definitely use them again.
Brought my guy QT in for his first groom and he is looking amazing! He got a bath, brush, nails clipped and it was very reasonable. They did a stellar job, will definitely be back.
My wire haired  sausage dog had her first proper trim here today. She looks amazing, exactly what I wanted!
The staff were very kind and helpful. They gave our cat a great haircut and thorough check of his hair. Thank you!
Great service. Very professional and knowledgeable. My cat is happy and looks so much cleaner than when he visited. Would recommend.
All good, efficient, swift and friendly service, very professional Tatti came home transformed into a very happy lion

Our dear but sometimes grumpy old spaniel Fred was looked after so, so well. He came out looking 5 years younger with his fresh cut and, he was much happier than before he’d gone in, especially in this heat wave.
He’d recently had a small procedure on one of his front paws and they were very careful not to disturb the area. Would definitely recommend.
Thanks for the 5 star review!

Went with our foster dog, who’s about 9 years old, just recently and they gave her so much attention and I like that they pick up on whether the dog is stressed or not. It was her very first time at a groomer but definitely not the last! Oatly will be a regular in no time!
Excellent cat grooming company. I was smitten when I saw my 2 cats look so well groomed. The staff is amazing and friendly, my cats really loved them. Thank you so much, we will definitely come back.

Our beautiful boy Rollo has now visited twice, and on both occasions he has come home looking as handsome as ever! 😍 The grooming is always completed to a very high standard, and it's clear a lot of care and attention goes into the work.

The only slight negative from our most recent visit was our interaction on arrival. We were around 7 minutes late for Rollo's 9:15am appointment after travelling over an hour with a baby, and one staff member immediately commented on how busy she was and stated that our appointment had been at 9:00am. I politely clarified that our booking was actually for 9:15am and apologised for being late. The interaction felt a little abrupt and not particularly welcoming.

That said, the quality of the grooming itself was excellent, just as it was on Rollo's first visit. He looked fantastic afterwards, and we'd like to thank the team for the care and attention they put into making him look his best.

I’ve had many great experiences with Absolutely Animals – Cat Grooming Salon, where I’ve been taking my three cats—Kovu, Bailey, and Bear—for the past 2–3 years.
The staff are always very friendly and professional, and they take excellent care of my three cats every time. I particularly appreciate how they share photos and videos during their grooming sessions when I come to collect them, which is a lovely touch and very reassuring. The salon itself is clean and welcoming, with quiet, calming music playing in the background, which really helps put both me and my cats at ease.
The results are consistently fantastic—my cats’ coats are soft, neatly trimmed, and they always seem much more comfortable afterwards. They also leave smelling amazing, and it lasts for days.
Overall, I believe the service offers great value for money, and knowing my cats are in safe and reliable hands gives me complete peace of mind. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Absolutely Animals to other cat owners.
Amazing staff, 1st time but definitely not the last time I’ll be in. Felt safe leaving my cat and she came out like a new non fully feline. Highly recommend
Beautifully groomed - my little hairy dog looks lovely and all the tangles and matted hair is gone.  She smells so much better too.

This is the third visit for Ollie to AA.  He will not let me groom him and had developed some bad knots I couldn't remove.  He is a large very fluffy tabby cat AA were brilliant and were able to remove all the knots.  A great service with  very friendly and knowledgeable staff.
Maggie loves her groom at Absolutely Animals, she is so happy to go in and comes out looking wonderful! The groomers are very friendly and are happy to share tips which have been very helpful.
Another amazing cut to my Cairn terrier today - always feel like we get the very best service possible from AA - lovely people and real masters of their craft - 10/10

I would recommend you to groom ur pets at Absolutely Animal. They are very friendly and I am happy with the work they did yesterday with my cat (Simba). He is very clean now compared to before the bath. So overall I am satisfied with their service.

Great experience with our old cat today. Arthritis and old age has meant he cannot groom himself the way he used to. Rather forlorn and matted we took him today to Absolutely Animals. Staff were incredibly sensitive to our somewhat neurotic old fella, and reassured us. Very reasonable price too. This was our second visit to Absolutely Animals, and won't hesitate to come back for further grooming sessions as necessary.

Very friendly and welcoming staff. I Had such a hard time finding groomers to service my very anxious terrier, I had given up hope until I found absolutely animals. Callum did an amazing job on my terrier. 10 out of 10. I can’t recommend enough.

Our cat had a wonderful groom at the Absolutely Animals cat grooming studio. Drop-off is easy, with parking outside, and the staff are friendly, welcoming and very obviously animal lovers. They took real care with him, and spent plenty of time making sure he was in wonderful condition. Online booking was simple, and the pricing was excellent for the amount of time they spent with him. We'll definitely be returning. Thanks to the team!
Great cat grooming! My cat was happy and very well taken care of! Thank you 🙏 …

I used Absolutely Animals for the first time today, and I can tell my pup was really happy with his time there. I found it nerve wracking finding a new groomer that they'll be gentle and treat him well, but they were lovely and seem to care a lot about animals. Plus he looks super cute and was done in 90mins. We'll definitely be back for his next one!

Absolutely brilliant tutor (Calum) to show me how to groom my little terrier.  Really knowledgable, helpful, calm, everything you would want from someone teaching and grooming your dog.  Lovely, friendly grooming/teaching studio - would absolutely recommend

Amazing service, very professional and non-judgemental environment, the advice they have given has been great. They are professional and they care about pets a lot. been looking for groomers for my cat for over 6 months and the team have been amazing! When collecting Alfie he was very happy! Can’t wait to bring him back alongside my other cat! Thank you so much to the management and the team once again! Can’t thank you enough.

A big Thank you to the ladies at Absolutely Animals. They took great care of my two lovely cats and gave them both the best grooming I could have hoped for. I highly recommend them to alll cat lovers.
Always a great service here for our cat Stevie. Kay and Sophia did  a great job on our last visit and we always feel very welcome when visiting. Thank you all for all you have done for Stevie so far!

Absolutely Animals do an amazing job of actually grooming the animals, but equally important, they are such lovely people and our cat is never stressed because of the peaceful and caring atmosphere. Highly recommend them!
Callum always does a fabulous groom. Highly recommended.

I’m absolutely disgusted with the service from Absolutely Animals.

I told them at drop-off that my dog has a growth on her neck and asked them to be careful. When I picked her up they acted like everything was fine and didn’t mention anything at all.

It wasn’t until I was on my way home that I noticed the growth had been cut open, was bleeding, and had turned dark black. I phoned them furious, and only then did they admit they’d cut it accidentally with a comb and treated it with potassium.

What I can’t get over is the fact they didn’t tell me at pick-up and just handed my dog back like nothing happened. That’s not an accident, that’s trying to cover it up.

Even after all of that, they still expected me to pay full price (which has gone up again) and all they offered was an apology. No accountability, no proper care, and no honesty. Never again.

Took my cockapoo for a full groom and teeth clean - really happy with the service. I asked for a teddy bear cut and it turned out exactly as hoped, despite the fact she went in with some matting around her face. Lovely, kind staff and great customer service — and my dog came back happy too. Thank you!

I’ve been adopted by an abandoned cat. We arranged the Vets visit followed by a flea bath at Absolutely Animals.
Cat( still looking for a name) came back shiny and new. I can’t see any sign of fleas or flea debris. The staff at this place are really sweet people. Gave me an urgent appointment and looked after my, yet to be named, cat so well. I highly recommend them.
Friendly and caring groomers, always take into consideration Shirley's age, she's 12, plus manage to get her dirty face white again which can be very stained as she's only got 2 teeth !

Our dog Teddy was not treated very well at previous groomers and left very anxious and shakey..but since being here at this groomers he comes out so happy, he is treated so nicely and given the perfect new hairdo..Nicole and the rest of the staff are so lovely and absolutely make a fuss of our dog..I'm so happy we found this groomer, highly recommended for nervous little dogs. Thankyou!!
Amazing experience! staff were super friendly and made sure my two cats were comfortable and well looked after and they came back looking beautiful 10/10

We take our cat Obi regularly to Absolutely Animals and I am told he loves his mini spa! I never worry about him, he is always in good hands and we collect him after the service, he is relaxed and happy. Great place if you are looking for your cats' first grooming session.
My dog has always had the best groom at Absolutely Animals.  It’s the only place she is happy to be left.  Very caring and an expert cut every time.
Absolutely fantastic! Highly recommend  Before and after. Bez loved every minute of her pampering.
The best staff and service. Dealt with my dog who hates have her claws cut so good couldn’t thank them enough.
My dogs have always enjoyed going to Absolutely Animals to be groomed.  They are looked after while they are there and look lovely when I pick them up.
The team are always fantastic with my 14-year-old Cavalier King Charles spaniel. They are very considerate, and he always comes out of his grooming session with wagging tail :-)

Took my 2 cats for a wash and de-shedding and I am extremely happy with the results. They had a foster break while I was away for 2 weeks and unfortunately I brought them back with fleas. The spot-on treatment didn't seem to be too effective, so I booked them in for a flea bath and a brushing, since the older one (short haired) hates being brushed and the younger one (while, long haired) can only tolerate it for a few mins at a time. They were both looking gorgeous when I picked them up, with their coats looking very shiny and silky. The longhaired boy looked particularly handsome and you could tell all the dead fur had been brushed out of his coat. I will definitely come back and wholeheartedly recommend Absolutely Animals.

Absolutely Animals is incredible with our cat, Coco. He’s a Maine Coon, so he has a lot of hair and they always take such incredible care of him. He comes back calm and clean and is back to his normal self in no time. I’ve had several cats in my life and used many different groomers in the U.S., China, and the UK, but Absolutely Animals is by far the best.
Very friendly staff, took time to ask what kind of style we wanted. Dog looks very smart now, excellent standard of groom. Very reasonable prices as well.

I got a grooming session for my birthday and the team at Absolutely Animals were fantastic, welcoming, super friendly and catered to all my needs so I left feeling fully confident about being able to groom my dog. Would highly recommend. Thank you so much guys.
A very efficient service, staff happy to give advice and very good at their jobs. Thank you.
Excellent customer service.

We had such a wonderful experience at the “Groom Your Own Dog” workshop today! Our tutor, Dulce, was very experienced, friendly, and patient. She showed us exactly how to handle our dog, Bibi, as it was his very first time in a grooming salon. We got lots of hands-on practical experience, learned so much about grooming, and even picked up some great pro tips to make the process smoother at home. It was a truly lovely experience for both Bibi and us. Thank you so much, Dulce! 🐾
Knowledgeable and friendly staff, that put a nervous parent at ease

These lovely people really care about and love cats. They are so friendly and make you feel welcome and confident they will do their best by you furry loved ones. Can’t praise them enough. The cats loved it. Thank you ladies! ♥️🙏🏼♥️ …
Great service, friendly and professional staff. Would highly recommend

Absolutely fantastic!!! A great experience all round ... It was our first visit but it won't be our last ... Great team, great energy and oodles of positivity, love and care!!! Many thanks indeed... S A and Daphne Dawg xxx
Love this place, my cat can be difficult, she doesn't like being groomed. The ladies are really good with her and understand, the always do a good job.

I purchased the aeolus trimmer which represents good value for money and seems reasonable quality. However please be aware that despite this being a UK based company the trimmers come with a European 2 pin charger plug meaning you will need to purchase and adaptor. This is not made clear in the advert on the website
